mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which may impair renal clearance of semaglutide and compromise glycemic control in patients with fungal infections.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and blood glucose closely during concurrent use; adjust semaglutide dosing if significant renal impairment develops; consider alternative antifungal agents if possible.
